bucket_seconds.title: Bucket Seconds
bucket_seconds.description: Width of each bucket, in seconds.

window_minutes.title: Window Minutes
window_minutes.description: The window the series covers, in minutes.

start.title: Start
start.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of the first bucket; null when no history has been recorded since the grid started. Bucket N covers start + N * bucket_seconds.

in_per_sec.title: In Per Sec
in_per_sec.description: Average messages entering the system per second, one entry per consecutive bucket. Null where nothing was sampled in that bucket.

out_per_sec.title: Out Per Sec
out_per_sec.description: Average messages fully processed and delivered per second, one entry per consecutive bucket. Null where nothing was sampled in that bucket.
